framework_decision.question: Standing golden-set/regression suite: DeepEval pytest-integration or native on the substrate?
framework_decision.decision: NATIVE, as pre-resolved at the Wave-0 decision gate. The harness already runs under pytest; E2 ships freeze_baseline/compare_to_baseline (the judge half of a regression check); the deterministic half is a fingerprint diff no framework ships. DeepEval's pytest lane earns in at E5 (G-Eval rubrics), in an online build session that can satisfy the API-currency guardrail.

design_decisions.two_lanes_deterministic_first: The golden set has a deterministic fingerprint lane (zero judge — claim ledger + prose hashes + canonical artifact hash; runs offline in CI today) and a judge lane (freeze_section_grounding/compare_section_grounding, thin wrappers over E2's grounding-invariance) that runs once the pinned judge is live. Deterministic-first routing: no judge is invoked where a hash/set comparison answers the question.
design_decisions.meaning_keyed_diff: The ledger diff matches claims by meaning — (claim_summary, status, source_ref), whitespace-normalized — never by bare claim_id (the E3/D1 lesson: ids repeat across independently-numbered drafting blocks; three unrelated C01s). entry_key (C01#171) is carried as the display label only. Identity sets are deduped (duplicate identical records are drafting noise, same posture as E3's dedup_ledger_claims); a claim_id relabel of an identical claim is deliberately not a finding.
design_decisions.breaking_vs_advisory: Breaking (a human must refreeze or fix): claim_removed, status_changed, source_ref_changed, subsection_removed, section_missing. Advisory: claim_added, subsection_added, section_added, prose_changed (char delta), prose_changed_ledger_unchanged (the escaped-claim risk zone — pointer to re-run E2/E3), confirmed_share_drop (grounding-density quality signal, default tolerance 0.05 absolute share, operator policy).
design_decisions.fail_closed: Freezing fails closed on a malformed section (no empty golden can bless anything); load_golden_set fails closed on an empty/missing golden dir (a check against no baselines would vacuously pass — the exact silence E4 exists to prevent); the CLI surfaces fail-closed as exit 2, distinct from drift (exit 1).
design_decisions.merge_advisory_ci: RegressionReport enforces advisory=True/blocking=False structurally (constructor rejects otherwise, mirroring HarnessReport). CI wiring is the standing pytest lane (marker harness_regression, registered in pyproject.toml) + the python -m harness.regression freeze|check CLI. A red check/test is advice to a human — refreeze and commit the golden diff in the same PR if intentional, investigate if not. Nothing in runner reads any E4 artifact; no DAG run consumes this lane.
